leakage_discipline: attention asof_date <= annotation_date minus 12 months (annotated pairs)
Snakefile validate rule must pass before expected_attention runs (guard file)

hurdle_annotated_at_all.verdict_use: informational; CONTRADICTS requires a written note (evidence_gate direction_verdict, null=0.0)

level_resistance.axes_rule: resistance axis ONLY (R1/R2). Separate model, separate report.

level_sensitivity.axes_rule: sensitivity axis ONLY (1/2/3A/3B/4). Never pooled with res_level.

negative_control.purpose: Surplus attention must NOT predict in-vitro dependency. If it does, the surplus carries generic essentiality signal and the annotation result is confounded.

prereg.note: Frozen before any interim table is built. Builders (workflow/build_*.py) are still TO_IMPLEMENT; nothing below may change once data is opened except by chained amendment snapshot.
open_items: ONCOGENICITY terms TO_VERIFY against current OncoKB before any annotated-model run
build_*.py adapters unimplemented; schemas are the contract
prereg.question: Does surplus literature attention to a gene predict OncoKB annotation of that gene in a cancer type, after adjusting for non-literature biology and enforcing a 12-month attention-to-annotation lag?

axes: attention measure (4 levels, hurdle variants for the hurdle model)
spec_curve.report: all cells, not the best cell
